name: documents
description: the working copy's documents as Markdown: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF text, HTML, CSV, JSON — in pieces, with an outline and tables row by row
notes: own server: repository mcp/Snail.MCP.Documents, a container with streamable HTTP. Runs ONE PER MACHINE beside mcp-filesystem and mounts the volume of working copies READ-ONLY. The session address names the copy: {workspace} is put into the path before the step; task attachments are under .swarm/attachments. A session for a copy this machine does not have, or for a folder outside /workspaces, is refused at the door; a browser request (an Origin header) gets 403. Three tools, all read-only: documents_outline (what is inside), documents_read (the text in pieces, pages, sheets and slides marked), documents_table (a table row by row). PDF scans are marked but not recognized: a vision model reads them. Files over 50 MB are not opened.
requires: The machine's volume of working copies at /workspaces, read-only
